instructions_to_main_agent: Core Layout: The entire app MUST be contained within a max-w-[430px] wrapper to simulate a mobile app experience on web. Center it on the screen with a neutral gray backdrop (bg-gray-100) outside the wrapper.
Brand Structure: Build 'SB Drive Client' for passengers and 'SB Drive Chauffeur' for drivers. You can toggle or route between them.

UI Vibe: Use pure white cards with very subtle borders (border-gray-100) and soft shadows. Apply rounded-2xl to cards and inputs. This contrasts sharply with the vibrant #00C853 green to create a high-end French VTC look.
Home Screen (Client): Use a 4-column Bento grid for services (Ride, Moto, Food, Parcel). Each item should have a light gray background icon wrapper and dark text.
Chauffeur App: Needs a massive 'Go Online' / 'Go Offline' toggle button at the top, a live map view (Leaflet), and a sleek bottom sheet for incoming ride requests.
Map Integration: Use React Leaflet. Make sure the map sits behind the UI elements (bottom sheets, top search bars) with proper z-index management.
Forms & Inputs: Do not use default HTML inputs. Create Shadcn-like customized inputs with padding, rounded-2xl, and the brand focus ring.
Bottom Navigation: Floating/Fixed at the bottom of the mobile wrapper. Must have glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90) and clearly indicate the active tab with the primary green color.
Fonts: Ensure 'Outfit' is used for Headings/brand names, and 'Satoshi' for body text. Add them to standard Tailwind sans stack.
data_testid_rules: You MUST add descriptive kebab-case 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements. E.g., data-testid='service-ride-btn', data-testid='go-online-toggle'.
